```{r}
#========================================================
# LR pair ORA: ligand-receptor genes enriched at the tumour-nerve
# interface, against a background of every gene tested across LIANA's
# LR pairs. The query list is the Tier 1 genes from 01_LR_analysis.ipynb.
#
# No deduplication or similarity filtering: all significant terms are
# saved as they are, and redundancy among nested or overlapping GO terms
# is left for the reader to judge, as is usual for a supplementary
# enrichment table.
#
# The script can be run on a different query list by changing
# QUERY_GENES_FILE. TIER_LABEL is derived from that filename and appears
# in every output name and cache path, so runs on different lists cannot
# overwrite each other.
#
# WHAT THIS PRODUCES (filenames shown for TIER_LABEL = "tier1")
# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Tables (output/03_LR_interface_ORA/tables/):
#   - LR_interface_ORA_FULL_tier1.csv
#       Every significant ORA term, unfiltered and undeduplicated; the
#       source table for the plots below.
# Figures (output/03_LR_interface_ORA/figures/):
#   - FigureS10D_LR_interface_enrichment_network_tier1.pdf
#       Figure S10D. Term-term network, edges where the terms share
#       driving genes (Jaccard > 0.1), top 40 terms by significance.
#   - exploratory_LR_interface_dotplot_by_significance_tier1.pdf
#       Top 25 terms by significance. NOT in the manuscript.
#   - exploratory_LR_interface_dotplot_selected_terms_tier1.pdf
#       Hand-picked terms, regardless of significance rank. NOT in the
#       manuscript, and `selected_terms` below is a placeholder list.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
# ========================================================

library(gprofiler2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# plyr masks several dplyr functions with incompatible signatures --
# pin the dplyr versions explicitly so this can't silently break again
rename    <- dplyr::rename
count     <- dplyr::count
recode    <- dplyr::recode
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "03_LR_interface_ORA"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Which gene list is this run using? --------------------------------
# The manuscript reports the ORA on the Tier 1 genes. TIER_LABEL is derived
# from this filename and drives every output name and cache path below, so
# a run on a different list cannot overwrite this one.
QUERY_GENES_FILE <- "LR_query_genes_Tier1_FINAL.csv"   # Tier 2: "LR_query_genes_Tier2_FINAL.csv"

TIER_LABEL <- regmatches(QUERY_GENES_FILE, regexpr("[Tt]ier[0-9]+", QUERY_GENES_FILE))
if (length(TIER_LABEL) == 0 || TIER_LABEL == "") {
  stop("Could not extract a Tier label (e.g. 'Tier1') from QUERY_GENES_FILE: ", QUERY_GENES_FILE,
       " -- rename the file to include TierN, or set TIER_LABEL manually below.")
}
TIER_LABEL <- tolower(TIER_LABEL)   # -> "tier1", "tier2", etc., used in all filenames below
cat("Running LR interface ORA for:", TIER_LABEL, "(", QUERY_GENES_FILE, ")\n\n")

# Cache control -- gost() is an external g:Profiler API call; cache it so
# downstream plotting chunks can be re-run without re-querying. Set to
# TRUE to force a fresh query even if a cache exists. Cache path is
# tier-specific, so switching QUERY_GENES_FILE above never loads a stale
# cache from a different gene list.
FORCE_RERUN_GOST <- FALSE
GOST_CACHE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, sprintf("lr_interface_gost_raw_%s.rds", TIER_LABEL))

# NOTE: LR_background_genes.csv and the query gene lists are written by
# 01_LR_analysis.ipynb. Copy them into input/ before running.
```

```{r}
background_genes <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "LR_background_genes.csv"))$gene
query_genes      <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, QUERY_GENES_FILE))$gene

cat("Background:", length(background_genes), "genes | Query:", length(query_genes), "genes\n")

if (file.exists(GOST_CACHE) && !FORCE_RERUN_GOST) {
  cat("Loading cached g:Profiler result from:", GOST_CACHE, "\n")
  lr_ora <- readRDS(GOST_CACHE)
} else {
  cat("Querying g:Profiler live (set FORCE_RERUN_GOST <- TRUE to force this even if a cache exists)...\n")
  lr_ora <- gost(query = query_genes,
                organism = "hsapiens",
                custom_bg = background_genes,
                correction_method = "fdr",
                evcodes = TRUE,
                sources = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC", "REAC", "KEGG"))
  saveRDS(lr_ora, GOST_CACHE)
  cat("Cached g:Profiler result to:", GOST_CACHE, "\n")
}

stopifnot(!is.null(lr_ora), nrow(lr_ora$result) > 0)
cat("Significant terms:", nrow(lr_ora$result), "\n")
```

```{r}
#========================================================
# 1) Save the full, non-deduplicated ORA result: every significant term,
# nothing collapsed or filtered.
#========================================================
lr_ora_full <- lr_ora$result %>%
  dplyr::rename(driving_genes = intersection) %>%
  dplyr::select(term_name, source, term_id, p_value, term_size, query_size,
               intersection_size, driving_genes, everything(), -parents)

LR_ORA_FULL_PATH <- file.path(TABLES_DIR, sprintf("LR_interface_ORA_FULL_%s.csv", TIER_LABEL))
readr::write_csv(lr_ora_full, LR_ORA_FULL_PATH)
cat("Saved:", nrow(lr_ora_full), "rows to", LR_ORA_FULL_PATH, "\n")
```

```{r}
#========================================================
# 2) Plot by significance -- top N terms, no deduplication, sorted by
# p value. Not in the manuscript.
#
# Re-read from disk rather than reusing lr_ora_full from memory, so this
# chunk and everything after it can be re-run on their own once the ORA
# table exists.
#========================================================
lr_ora_full <- read.csv(LR_ORA_FULL_PATH)

top_n <- 25

plot_by_sig <- lr_ora_full %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  head(top_n) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10p = -log10(p_value),
    term_specificity = intersection_size / term_size,
    term_name = factor(term_name, levels = rev(term_name[order(p_value)]))
  )

ggplot(plot_by_sig, aes(x = neglog10p, y = term_name, size = term_specificity)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2a78d6") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Term specificity\n(intersection/term size)", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(x = expression(-log[10](italic(p))), y = NULL,
       title = "Enrichment at the tumour-nerve interface (LR pairs)",
       subtitle = paste0("Top ", top_n, " terms by significance (unfiltered)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, sprintf("exploratory_LR_interface_dotplot_by_significance_%s.pdf", TIER_LABEL)), width = 7, height = 8)
```

```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(1234)

# ---- Tunable text/label sizes -----------------------------------------
NODE_LABEL_SIZE <- 2.5     # was 2.5 -- increase for bigger node labels
TITLE_SIZE <- 8
SUBTITLE_SIZE <- 8
LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE <- 6
LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE <- 6

top_n_network <- 40
network_terms <- lr_ora_full %>% arrange(p_value) %>% head(top_n_network)

term_gene_list <- network_terms %>%
  select(term_name, driving_genes) %>%
  mutate(genes = strsplit(driving_genes, ",")) %>%
  { setNames(lapply(.$genes, trimws), .$term_name) }

jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
term_names <- names(term_gene_list)
n <- length(term_names)
edges <- data.frame()
# seq_len(n - 1) rather than 1:(n - 1), so that n = 1 gives no iterations.
if (n >= 2) {
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      sim <- jaccard(term_gene_list[[i]], term_gene_list[[j]])
      if (sim > 0.1) {
        edges <- rbind(edges, data.frame(from = term_names[i], to = term_names[j], weight = sim))
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Fewer than 2 terms in network_terms -- no edges to compute.\n")
}

nodes <- network_terms %>%
  select(term_name, p_value, intersection_size, source) %>%
  mutate(neglog10p = -log10(p_value))

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes, directed = FALSE)

p_network <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = intersection_size, color = neglog10p)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = NODE_LABEL_SIZE, repel = TRUE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2), name = "Gene overlap\n(Jaccard)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Genes in term", range = c(2, 10)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = expression(-log[10](italic(p)))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = TITLE_SIZE, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = SUBTITLE_SIZE),
    legend.text = element_text(size = LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE),
    legend.title = element_text(size = LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Enrichment network: tumour-nerve interface LR pairs",
      subtitle = paste0("Top ", top_n_network, " terms; edges = shared driving genes"))

print(p_network)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, sprintf("FigureS10D_LR_interface_enrichment_network_%s.pdf", TIER_LABEL)),
      p_network, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi=600)
```

#========================================================
# 3) Plot by hand-selected term names, regardless of significance rank.
# Not in the manuscript; the list below is a placeholder.
#========================================================
selected_terms <- c(
  # Placeholder list -- edit if this plot is ever used.
  "vasculature development",
  "nervous system development",
  "cell motility",
  "glial cell differentiation"
)

plot_by_selection <- lr_ora_full %>%
  filter(term_name %in% selected_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10p = -log10(p_value),
    term_specificity = intersection_size / term_size,
    term_name = factor(term_name, levels = rev(term_name[order(p_value)]))
  )

missing_terms <- setdiff(selected_terms, lr_ora_full$term_name)
if (length(missing_terms) > 0) {
  cat("NOT FOUND in results -- check exact spelling:\n")
  print(missing_terms)
}

ggplot(plot_by_selection, aes(x = neglog10p, y = term_name, size = term_specificity)) +
  geom_point(color = "#eb6834") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Term specificity\n(intersection/term size)", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(x = expression(-log[10](italic(p))), y = NULL,
       title = "Selected terms of interest at the tumour-nerve interface") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, sprintf("exploratory_LR_interface_dotplot_selected_terms_%s.pdf", TIER_LABEL)), width = 7, height = 5)
